prepaid.title: Prepaid packages and gifts
prepaid.description: One-time payment, no automatic renewal. Lets people gift the plan and use coupons, two things Mercado Pago's recurring billing doesn't allow. With no package, the plan stays recurring only.
prepaid.lifetimeHint: Paid once and access never expires.
prepaid.savingHint: With the recurring subscription it would cost {price}, so this package gives {saving}.
prepaid.equivalent: Same as {price} on the recurring subscription.

activate.title: When the subscription starts
activate.hint: Runs on the first approved charge and on every renewal. That's why a recurring in-game credit works on its own, and granting a role the person already has again does no harm.

cancel.title: When it's canceled or expires
cancel.hint: What gets taken back when the subscription ends. With no action here, the subscriber keeps what they received.

actions.roleHierarchy: ⚠️ The bot's role must be above this role in the server hierarchy.
actions.noGameActions: No action set up in the {module} module (Actions tab).

preview.title: Store preview
preview.hint: This is how the plan shows up in the public store; it updates as you edit.

errors.nameTooShort: Name must be at least 2 characters.

plan.subtitle: Set the name, price, billing period and the role the bot gives to active subscribers.
plan.name: Plan name
plan.benefitsPlaceholder:
One benefit per line, e.g.:
Exclusive VIP role
Queue priority
Early access to scripts
plan.benefitsHint: Write {emphasis}; in the store it becomes a list with ✓.
plan.imageHint: Becomes the plan's thumbnail in the public store, just like a product image.
plan.galleryHint: Shown as a carousel below the main image on the plan page.

discount.existingLead: Only applies to people who subscribe from now on.
discount.existingSubscribers: {lead} Mercado Pago locks the amount in each person's subscription when they authorize the payment, so the {count} current subscribers keep paying what they already pay. When the promotion ends, whoever joined during it also stays on the promotional price until they cancel.
discount.newOnly: The discount applies to people who subscribe from now on. Mercado Pago locks the amount in each person's subscription, so changing the price later doesn't affect current subscribers.

plan.publicListedHint: When on, this plan appears at {url}. Off = only reachable by direct link ("invite-only VIP" model).
plan.donationHint: Checkout becomes a donation: the payer must confirm they understand it's a voluntary, non-refundable donation, and the accepted text is stored for each subscriber.
plan.donationNoticeHint: Say what the person gets as a thank-you and that there are no refunds. Empty uses the example text.

section.title: Subscriptions
section.lockDescription: Charge members a monthly fee, with a role while the subscription is active.
section.disabledDescription: Create plans with recurring billing. The bot gives the role to active subscribers and removes it when the subscription ends.

overview.trendTitle: Cumulative joins and cancellations over 30 days
overview.noTrend: Nobody joined or left in the last 30 days.

events.failedRecent: {count, plural, one {# failure} other {# failures}} in the last 24h
events.empty: No events yet. Charges, roles given and removed, cancellations and notices sent show up here.

deactivate.title: Deactivate the "{name}" plan?
deactivate.description: New subscribers won't be able to sign up, but those who already have the plan keep it until they cancel.

planList.empty: No plans yet. Start by creating a plan (e.g. "VIP Bronze R$10/month").

grant.grantedLifetime: Lifetime subscription granted, the plan's role and actions applied.
grant.grantedUntil: Subscription granted until {date}, the plan's role and actions applied.
grant.title: Add subscriber manually
grant.description: For people who paid outside the bot (direct Pix, complimentary). Activates right away with the plan's role and actions, with no Mercado Pago charge, and expires on its own at the end of the period.

subscribers.searchPlaceholder: Search name, plan, ID or email
subscribers.pendingHint: {status} = subscribed but hasn't paid the 1st charge yet. Doesn't count as a supporter or get the role until the payment is confirmed.

cancel.title: Cancel subscription?
cancel.silentDescription: Cancels the recurrence on Mercado Pago and removes the role, without sending the member a DM. Good for cleaning up a checkout left pending.
cancel.description: Cancels the recurrence on Mercado Pago and removes the member's role. This does not refund earlier payments; use the "Refund" button on each charge if you need to reverse one.
cancel.silentHint: Cancels without sending the member a DM

recheck.hint: Checks Mercado Pago and activates the subscription if the payment has already been made.

refund.title: Refund {amount}?
refund.description: Mercado Pago will reverse this amount to the subscriber's card (up to 90 days after the payment). The subscription stays active; to cancel it too, use "Cancel subscription".

details.noPayments: No charges recorded yet. They show up when Mercado Pago bills the recurrence.
details.noGameActions: No in-game actions triggered by this plan.
